title: Tone's Racing Modpack
description: This is a simple modpack of all allowed mods for my Race Course Challenge, which will eventually be used for racing events - mainly using Create Aeronautics cars.
body:
This is a simple little modpack to be used for my Race Course Challenge, where I have challenged people to design race courses to use for Create Aeronautics racing! This pack can be used by people designing race courses, but will also be used in the future for communities who want to race!

**Mechanical Mods**
_These are the mods required for the cars to function_
- Create
- Create Aeronautics
- Sable

**Decorative Mods**
_Optional mods that will help people add some extra details to their race courses_
- Create Deco
- Create: Interiors
- Create: Design n' Decor
- Create: Bells & Whistles
- Copycats+
- Dye Depot
- Dye the World

**Extra Mods**
- Create: Sound of Steam (add music to your machinations!)
- Jade (see what mod the thing youre looking at is from)
- EMI (easy way to browse blocks in the pack)

This pack is to be used in relation to the challenge detailed in this video: https://youtu.be/30F_AkN3o9U
